channel.title: Antalya transfer guides | Antalya VIP Tourism
channel.description: Practical guides to arriving in Antalya: airport transfers versus taxis, meeting your driver, travelling with children, distances along the coast and when to visit.

item.title: Antalya in autumn: what to do in October and November
item.description: The sea is still warm, the crowds have gone home and the heat has broken. Why October and November are the best-kept secret on the Turkish Riviera.

item.title: Antalya in winter: what to do between December and February
item.description: Mild days, snow on the mountains and a city that belongs to its residents again. What Antalya offers between December and February - and what it does not.

item.title: Christmas and New Year in Antalya
item.description: Sunny days, a New Year's gala by the sea and the town of St Nicholas two and a half hours away. How to plan the holidays in Antalya, and how to get there on the night.

item.title: Spending the winter in Antalya: a guide for long stays
item.description: Weeks or months of mild weather instead of a northern winter. What long-stay visitors should know before spending the winter in Alanya, Side or Antalya.

item.title: Cappadocia in winter: a trip from Antalya
item.description: Fairy chimneys under snow and balloons over a white valley. How to combine a winter stay in Antalya with Cappadocia, and what the road is like in winter.

item.title: Winter golf in Belek
item.description: Mild days, green fairways and quieter tee sheets. What golfers should know about playing Belek between November and March, when home courses are closed.

item.title: Skiing near Antalya: the Saklıkent ski centre
item.description: Ski in the morning, walk by the sea in the afternoon. A practical guide to Saklıkent, Antalya's own ski centre, and how to get there from the coast.

item.title: Antalya in spring: what to do between March and May
item.description: Orange blossom in the streets, snow on the peaks and the sea warming week by week. Why spring is the season for active holidays around Antalya.

item.title: Private transfer, taxi or shared shuttle from Antalya Airport?
item.description: Three ways to leave Antalya Airport, three very different arrival experiences. Here is what each one costs, how long it takes and who it suits.

item.title: Arriving at Antalya Airport: what happens after you land
item.description: From wheels down to the vehicle door: terminals, passport control, the meeting point and what happens when the flight is late.

item.title: Antalya Airport to Alanya: how far it really is
item.description: Alanya is the longest of the popular Antalya transfers. Here is the real distance, the real driving time and what changes on a night arrival.

item.title: Travelling to your hotel with children
item.description: Child seats are free on request, but only if we know about them before you land. What to tell us, and what actually fits in the vehicle.

item.title: Antalya Airport to Belek with golf bags
item.description: Belek is a golf destination first and a beach resort second. What that means for luggage space, vehicle choice and the drive from AYT.

item.title: When to visit Antalya - and how the season changes your arrival
item.description: Every season on the Turkish Riviera has a different arrival experience. What changes between April and October, and why it matters on the road.
